data.exact_reserve_text: During 2020, the following amounts are proposed to be transferred to the members' personal reserve fund. 2018 Year of Account: (8.1)

named_events.loss_description: Our booked losses relating to Covid-19 are GBP 26.3m which translates into an increase in our Combined Ratio of 25 percentage points. The majority of these losses were from event cancellation covers.
The most destructive of these was Hurricane Laura which made landfall in Louisiana.
Other events worth noting were Storm Derecho

named_events.event_name: wildfire losses across the Western United States
named_events.loss_description: a series of wildfire losses across the Western United States.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net prior year strengthening of GBP 8.1 million for the 2018 year of account, representing a loss transferred to members' personal reserve funds. This resulted in a negative 3.2% return on stamp capacity for the 2018 year of account. The specific causes for this prior year strengthening were not detailed in the report. The 2020 financial year was significantly impacted by GBP 26.3 million in booked losses related to the Covid-19 pandemic, primarily from event cancellation covers, and by frequent natural catastrophes including Hurricane Laura, Storm Derecho, and wildfires in the Western United States.
raw_causal_phrases: loss to capital providers from the 2018 and prior years of a negative 3.2% return
booked losses relating to Covid-19 are GBP 26.3m
majority of these losses were from event cancellation covers
performance in 2020 was impacted by the frequency of natural catastrophes rather than the severity of individual events seen in previous years
impact of these natural catastrophes worsened the Combined Ratio by 25.3 percentage points after reinsurance/retrocessional recoveries

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development is reported as a net figure of GBP 8.1m, representing a loss for the 2018 Year of Account transferred to members' personal reserve fund. A gross figure was not explicitly stated, and the claims development triangle is considered unreliable for prior year development calculation due to a Part VII transfer and Reinsurance to Close transaction mentioned in note 22. The percentage is calculated against net opening claims outstanding. The 'Fire and other damage to property' line of business shows a negative gross premium written, as reported in the document.
